verdict.rationale: Netlify documents the full version, review and rollback loop for deploys: auto-deploy on every push, Deploy Previews to review each change before it goes live, and one-click rollback of any deploy. Since serverless functions ship inside deploys, this plausibly covers code-defined automations, but the evidence never ties these controls to automations specifically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that functions or automations are versioned and rolled back with deploys, automation-specific history or diff review, and independent hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
